strategy: Three-phase LLM pipeline: (1) theme discovery from stratified sample, (2) chunk-based classification of all reviews into themes, (3) persona generation per group.
phase_1_prompt_summary: Given a stratified sample of reviews, identify exactly 5 distinct user-situation themes.
phase_2_prompt_summary: For each chunk of 100 reviews, assign every review to the closest theme by group_id.
phase_3_prompt_summary: For each group, generate a structured persona with name, goals, pain points, and context.

discovered_themes.description: Users experiencing frequent crashes, bugs, and technical difficulties that hinder their meditation practice
Users concerned about the cost of the app, feeling it's too expensive or not worth the price, and some seeking free or more affordable options
Users struggling with the app's interface, navigation, and organization, finding it difficult to find content or use the app effectively
Users who have found the app helpful for their meditation practice, mental health, and stress management, and appreciate its positive impact on their lives
Users unhappy with recent updates, changes to the app's design or functionality, or the introduction of new features that they find unnecessary or frustrating
